summary.text: Bill Irwin is a Republican member of the Missouri House of Representatives, District 55, who assumed office on January 8, 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists him as William Irwin; he served in the U.S. Navy from 1983 to 2017.

paragraphs.text: William Irwin was born in St. Louis, Missouri, and served in the U.S. Navy from 1983 to 2017.
He earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Missouri in 1979 and a graduate degree from the U.S. Naval War College in 2009.
In the Missouri House, Irwin was assigned to the Joint Committee on Government Accountability for 2025-2026.
